changelog:
Initial public release of meme-generator: generate crisp SVG memes from text using classic templates.

- Supports popular meme templates (Drake, Stonks, Doge, This is Fine, etc.)
- Generate single or batch memes from the command line
- Includes quote packs for programming, startup, productivity, and student humor
- Animated SVG text effects and HTML export options available
- Pure Python standard library; no external dependencies required
- Easily extendable with custom SVG templates
summary: Generate SVG-based memes from text — classic templates (Drake, Stonks, This is Fine, Doge, etc.), batch generation, quote packs, animated effects. Pure Python stdlib, crisp at any resolution.
